turns.question: What was our ROAS in September 2026, counting the value of bookings against ad spend?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no ROAS metric, so I can't give a figure for September 2026. The closest metrics are Booking value (EUR), the value of bookings made, and Ad spend (EUR), the ad spend across campaigns; the layer does not divide one by the other, and I did not run a query for that period, so no freshness statement applies.
